artifact_plan.purpose: Primary printable, fillable planner containing 30-week timeline overview, monthly pages, weekly checklist pages and single-day checklist sections; optimized for A4 and US Letter.
artifact_plan.generation_instructions: Create a print-ready, fillable PDF with named form fields. Include: cover/title page, key dates & contacts, 30-week timeline overview (rows per week with 3–6 action slots), monthly overview pages (month name header + top 4–5 goals), weekly checklist pages (repeatable template), and a single-page printable vendor contact & payments tracker and budget snapshot. Use clear typography, adequate margins for printing, 1–2 accent colors, and export as both A4 and US Letter. Ensure field names match spreadsheet columns where applicable.

artifact_plan.purpose: Master editable source spreadsheet with tabs for timeline, monthly checklist, weekly checklist, vendor tracker, budget snapshot, and example filled data.
artifact_plan.generation_instructions: Produce a single .xlsx file with these tabs: '30-Week Timeline' (auto-calc week numbers/dates from wedding date input, columns: week_no, start_date, end_date, key_tasks, priority), 'Monthly Overview' (month name, top goals), 'Weekly Checklist' (repeating template with checkboxes/status column), 'Vendors' (vendor, contact, contract signed Y/N, deposit, balance, due date), 'Budget' (category, budgeted, actual, remaining formulas), 'Example Filled' (sample data showing a realistic timeline). Add simple formulas (SUM for budget, conditional formatting for overdue payments), dropdowns for status, and comments with usage tips. Use clean column names to map to PDF fields.

artifact_plan.purpose: Step-by-step instructions for buyer to create a Google Sheets copy from the XLSX and set sharing permissions; includes shorthand for importing to Google Drive and recommended view/edit settings.
artifact_plan.generation_instructions: Write concise, numbered steps: how to upload the XLSX to Google Drive, open with Google Sheets, make a copy, set drop-down/checkbox equivalents, and enable offline editing. Provide troubleshooting tips (date issues, formula compatibility) and recommended folder organization. Include a short note: 'If you prefer, reply for a personalized Google Sheets share for an additional service.'

artifact_plan.purpose: Demonstration file showing a realistic, example-filled timeline so buyers can see how to use the template and what a completed schedule looks like.
artifact_plan.generation_instructions: Populate the template with realistic sample entries (vendor booking, dress fittings, invites timeline, payment milestones). Ensure sample dates correspond to a hypothetical wedding date 30 weeks out. Emphasize clarity and show how weekly tasks roll into monthly goals.

artifact_plan.purpose: Printable vendor contact & payments tracker derived from spreadsheet for quick physical reference at meetings.
artifact_plan.generation_instructions: Export the 'Vendors' tab as a single-page printable PDF with columns: Vendor, Role, Contact, Contract Signed (Y/N), Deposit, Balance, Due Date, Notes. Use clear spacing to allow handwritten notes when printed.

artifact_plan.purpose: Buyer-facing step-by-step usage guide covering PDF fillable fields, spreadsheet editing, printing tips, and quick-start checklist.
artifact_plan.generation_instructions: Write a friendly, concise guide (approx. 300–600 words) including: quick-start (how to pick a wedding date and generate weeks), editing tips for PDF vs spreadsheet, printing recommendations (paper size, bleed), how to use the example file, and common FAQs (date formats, formula quirks). Include short screenshots or placeholder notes indicating where screenshots can be added later.

artifact_plan.purpose: Clear manifest for buyers listing each file in the bundle and its purpose.

artifact_plan.purpose: Concise buyer-facing benefits list used in listing and preview overlays.

Include subfolders: /editable/ (XLSX), /printable/ (fillable PDF, example PDF), /docs/ (how_to_use.md, included_files.md, key_benefits.md), /listing/ (etsy_title.txt, etsy_description.md, etsy_tags.txt), /preview/ (preview_plan.md, preview_assets_manifest.json), and final_manifest.json.
